title: CoWin homepage — pushed beyond the standard hero
question: These directions replace the ecommerce hero skeleton itself. Choose one world, ask for a hybrid, or re-roll again.

options.label: Lensworld
options.lineage: first-person sport vision, optical masks and product-shaped navigation
options.thesis: The glasses are not shown on the homepage—the homepage exists inside the glasses.
options.viewport: An enormous G200 frame extends beyond the viewport; each lens is a live scene, navigation follows the brow, and buying happens inside the lens.
options.risk: The frame mask must adapt carefully on narrow screens so the product-shaped interface remains usable.

options.label: Carbon / Chrome
options.lineage: raku fracture, performance materials and severe fashion campaigns
options.thesis: CoWin becomes an object revealed by heat, fracture and smoke rather than a product on a white sweep.
options.viewport: A giant diagonal G200 interrupts a fractured headline while its real price glows from an ember seam and V03-T5 appears through smoke.
options.risk: This world is powerful and premium but demands disciplined restraint across policy, account and support pages.
options.case: Strongest fashion authority and material identity while keeping one decisive product action.

options.label: Signal Deck 39.99
options.lineage: precision laboratory instruments and glowing number tubes
options.thesis: Shopping becomes tuning: rotate the model selector, watch the real price arrive, then activate the frame.
options.viewport: G200 is suspended inside one full-screen instrument, USD 39.99 glows behind it, and a physical selector switches to GL1 or V03-T5.
options.risk: Most ownable interaction, but the industrial character is less natural for softer everyday and fashion frames.
options.case: Highest memorability and product-specific interaction; narrower emotional range than Lensworld.

canonCard.label: Return to premium convention
canonCard.thesis: The restrained category-standard option remains available if experimentation stops serving the sale.
canonCard.viewport: Editorial copy and one large product share a familiar premium ecommerce viewport.
canonCard.risk: Clear and safe, but already rejected for lacking a distinctive CoWin point of view.
